'''Stargram''' is a device used to link with mech's to take control.<ref>[[Fassdorf]]</ref><ref>[[Dagdir]]</ref>

There isn't many information on what Stargram is beyond that any students from different department have access to it.<ref>[[Tae]]</ref> Given that a [[Starstack]] is said to be for [[Startorch Academy]]'s personnel, it is believed that a Stargram is the three star pieces commonly worn by students and expeditioners.
